description: Up to 144 consecutive Bitcoin blocks descending from fromHeight (or tip). Returns height, hash, time, size, weight, tx count, fees, subsidy, reward, median fee sat/vB, and pool name for each block. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

count.description: Number of consecutive blocks to return, 1 to 144 (default 15)

fromHeight.description: Starting block height (descending downwards, optional default: latest tip)
